overview.title: Game Overview
overview.description: Werewolf is a deduction game where players are divided into villager and werewolf teams. Through daytime discussions and voting, and nighttime role actions, teams aim to eliminate the opposing faction.

gameFlow.title: Game Flow
gameFlow.step1Desc: At game start, each player is randomly assigned a role. Keep your role secret.
gameFlow.step2Desc: Werewolves choose someone to attack, seers choose someone to divine. Each role uses their ability.
gameFlow.step3Desc: Night results are announced. Everyone discusses and deduces who might be a werewolf.
gameFlow.step4Desc: After discussion, vote to execute someone. The person with the most votes is executed.
gameFlow.step5Desc: Repeat steps 2-4 until one team's victory condition is met.

teams.title: Teams
teams.werwolvesDesc: Win by reducing villagers to equal or fewer than werewolves
teams.foxDesc: Win by surviving until the end (solo)

roles.title: Role List
roles.werewolfDesc: Can attack and kill one person at night. Knows other werewolves. Detected as werewolf when divined.
roles.villagerDesc: No special abilities, but a fundamental villager team role. Find werewolves through discussion and voting.
roles.seerDesc: Can divine one person at night to learn if they're a werewolf. A crucial information source for the villager team.
roles.mediumDesc: Can learn if the person executed the previous day was a werewolf. Cooperate with the seer to identify werewolves.
roles.knightDesc: Can protect one person at night from werewolf attacks. Guard important players.
roles.madmanDesc: A villager on the werewolf team. Appears as villager when divined. Pretend to be a werewolf to confuse the village.
roles.foxDesc: Third faction. Survives werewolf attacks but dies if divined. Win solo by surviving until the end.
roles.twinsDesc: A pair of roles. Know each other's identity. Cooperate as the villager team.

tips.title: Victory Tips
tips.tip1Desc: Observe who's telling the truth by watching for contradictions and behaviours.
tips.tip2Desc: Make the most of your role's abilities and contribute to your team.
tips.tip3Desc: Record each player's statements and actions to find inconsistencies.
tips.tip4Desc: Silence raises suspicion. Actively participate in discussions.
